title: Gate key under the soil line
body: The map has a wet thumbprint over the field rows. The key tag reads SAMPLE GATE, and its metal is dusted with the same pale soil. A red pencil circles the word KEEP OUT.
rival_reading: A farm gate could be restricted during ordinary testing, with a key left in the mud after a warning; the arrangement does not prove the response itself failed.
gloss: A restricted gate key lies beside a field map marked by use rather than by a completed route.

title: Bottle marked after the rows
body: The clipboard has three field rows, each checked. The bottle is full and marked AFTER APPLICATION, but the source line is empty. A worker has pressed a thumb into the paper instead of signing it.
rival_reading: A response crew could check field rows after a diversion and leave the source for later; an unsigned bottle record does not show that an agricultural program malfunctioned.
gloss: Checked field rows and a bottle marked after application remain without a source or signature.
